bootstrapPromptText: Integrate yourself with this AstrBot-Gateway. Read GATEWAY_URL and GATEWAY_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN from the environment. First read /.well-known/astrbot-gateway, then follow only the Gateway-returned registration and authenticated-bootstrap links. Read the Agent Integration Contract and create an independent Gateway Adapter/Sidecar appropriate to your runtime: prefer HTTP mode for a persistent service, or command mode for a CLI Agent. Do not modify Gateway or put platform logic in Agent Core. Map astrbot.agent.invoke.v1 to AgentFlow and return astrbot.agent.result.v1 with structured segments. Persist a stable mapping from Gateway session key to native session. Run doctor and complete an inbound-to-outbound round trip.
